title: Azimut 80
description:
This 2018 Azimut 80 has four guest cabins (master, VIP and two doubles) for eight guests and two crew cabins. Large side windows fill her interior with natural light.

Twin MAN V12 1,800 HP engines with 1,050 hours give a 24-knot cruise, with CMC electric fin stabilisers and two Onan 27 kW generators. Price and location on request.
